**Product Title:**  
SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch

**Short Marketing Description:**  
Stay connected, track your wellness, and move through your day with confidence using the SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch. Featuring a vibrant 1.9-inch AMOLED display, Bluetooth calling, and all-day fitness and health tracking, it’s designed to support your active lifestyle with style and convenience.

**Key Features:**  
- 1.9-inch AMOLED display for a clear, premium viewing experience  
- Bluetooth calling to keep you connected without reaching for your phone  
- Up to 7-day battery life for dependable everyday use  
- Heart-rate monitoring to help you stay on top of your wellness  
- Sleep tracking to better understand your rest patterns  
- IP68 waterproof design for added durability and peace of mind  
- Fitness activity tracking to support your daily movement goals  

**Promotional Tagline:**  
Smart living, fitness tracking, and everyday convenience — all on your wrist.
